'''Salla Zend''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who was the ex-girlfriend of [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]. She and cohort [[Shug Ninx]] later helped Solo and his wife [[New Republic Senate/Legends|New Republic Senator]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] save [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and foil the reborn [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] plan to control the galaxy from [[Byss/Legends|Byss]] years after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] with her remarkably fast ship, the ''[[Starlight Intruder]]'' (which Zend often claimed was faster than the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], but in a number of races with the Falcon, the Intruder never came out on top).

==Biography==
[[File:StalightIntruder.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Salla's ''[[Starlight Intruder]]''.]]
Zend was originally a student with a true gift for fixing and modifying machinery, yet she didn't seek training to become an [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] or a [[Technician/Legends|technician]], preferring to become a [[Starship/Legends|spaceship]] mechanic aboard a corporate vessel. Eventually, she saved up enough money for a loan, with which she bought her own ship.

Her first time on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] was eventful, with her getting into a fight with a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] named "[[Jump]]," who tried to romance her at first, but then tried to be rough; his roughness only got him a dislocated shoulder. Tweaking out her vessel, the [[Rimrunner (Gymsnor-4)|''Rimrunner'']], Zend began repaying the debt by smuggling with [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]].<ref name="The Hutt Gambit">''[[The Hutt Gambit]]''</ref>

She was one of the many smugglers who fought in the [[Battle of Nar Shaddaa (4 BBY)|Battle of Nar Shaddaa]] where she and [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] in the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] were partnered up. During the battle, she personally destroyed three [[Guardian-class light cruiser|''Guardian''-class light cruisers]] with her ship's [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missiles]].<ref name="The Hutt Gambit" />

A race with Solo past a [[Neutron star/Legends|neutron star]] almost ended in disaster when her [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] failed and Solo nearly died rescuing her. Disturbed by the narrow miss, Zend wished to marry Solo, but he refused and said goodbye to her.<ref name="Rebel Dawn">''[[Rebel Dawn]]''</ref> She later partnered up with [[Shug Ninx]].<ref name="Dark Empire">[[Dark Empire 3|''Dark Empire'' 3]]</ref>

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Salla Zend and the ''Starlight Intruder'' first appeared in the third issue of the ''[[Star Wars: Dark Empire]]'' series, [[Dark Empire 3|''Dark Empire'' 3]].

Vocal actress [[Glynnis Talken Campbell|Glynnis Talken]] played Salla in the [[1994]] [[Dark Empire (audio drama)|''Dark Empire'' audio drama]]. In [[1995]], Talken acted out Salla again in the [[Dark Empire II (audio drama)|''Dark Empire II'' audio drama]].

Although the first edition of ''[[The Essential Guide to Characters]]'' would firmly establish Salla's [[Species/Legends|species]] as Human, she does have a "purr" and slight [[Alien/Legends|alien]] reverb to her voice in these audio adaptations.
